payload.text: ST0092 WP-11, THE ESTATE SWEEP, on hv's go (2026-11-11, rulings: the five stale hv messages cleared; Prodinfra and Riffle solo; Pipeliner converges with sc as it stands and sc retires as a separate step; gyges and kovacs upgraded to 3.3.0 by hv). Laksa needed its own inbox guard taught that the profile apply's declaration sanctions removing the views of pairs with hv (hv chose that over a --no-verify commit). Four Intent projects in the client tree have no board and get none (hv: 'Maybe not'). Pipeliner's sc retirement is still to do. Two Intent defects filed for the next release.
